chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Tubuh, Hormon, dan Warisan Leluhur
side_a_text: Kamu menyalahkan orang lain atas amarahmu yang meledak, padahal ragamu hanya sedang kelelahan merawat racun di dalam darah.
visual_concept: Seseorang duduk termenung di angkringan temaram tepat di bawah kolong jembatan layang Yogyakarta (Lempuyangan/Janti) saat senja beraspal basah; di cangkir seng lurik miliknya, uap hangat yang naik membentuk siluet halus menyerupai serabut saraf biologis.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian man in his late 20s in simple linen shirt, sitting quietly at a weathered roadside angkringan wooden bench * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Underneath a massive concrete Yogyakarta flyover bridge at dusk, wet asphalt reflecting streetlights, parked motorcycle nearby, rough concrete pillars * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Hands cupping a warm vintage striped enamel tin mug (cangkir seng lurik), looking down with weary introspection, exhausted yet seeking stillness * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] Faint translucent steam rising from the hot drink subtly traces microscopic fractal branching patterns reminiscent of human nervous capillaries in warm amber light * [LIGHTING] Moody twilight ambience, soft warm tungsten glow from a single hanging bulb casting deep shadows and quiet gradients * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Raw wet asphalt texture, weathered teak wood grain, aged enamel mug with chipped edges, humid tropical evening atmosphere * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 portrait orientation, medium shot, subject in lower two-thirds, generous atmospheric negative space in the upper portion beneath the concrete flyover ceiling for editorial text * [STYLE] Cinematic 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 tone curve, rich shadow details, subtle natural film grain, muted earthy palette with charcoal, bone, and amber accents * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No futuristic cyborgs, no glowing alien sci-fi graphics, no neon lights, no text, no typography, no watermarks, no distorted anatomy, no cartoonish rendering
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Sampul & Pembuka: Di Bawah Deru Kolong Jembatan, Biokimia Batin, dan Mitologi Saraf Raga
self_reflection_check: Kalau belakangan gampang marah, coba jangan cuma menyalahkan orang. Tidurmu beberapa malam terakhir berapa jam?
teaser: Di balik gampang marah, gelisah, dan lelah, ada tubuh yang sedang bekerja lebih keras daripada yang kita kira.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Saat Piring Pecah, Apa yang Sebenarnya Pecah?
side_a_text: Piring tanah liat itu sudah selesai pecah di lantai. Kamulah yang terus memungut pecahannya dan menusukkannya ke dadamu berhari-hari.
visual_concept: Lantai dapur semen ekspos sederhana khas rumah Indonesia dengan serakan pecahan piring keramik putih bermotif bunga vintage di dekat kaki telanjang seseorang; pantulan air di lantai semen membelah retakan menjadi dua rona halus: hangat membara di satu sisi dan jernih tenang di sisi lain.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] Fragments of a shattered vintage floral ceramic plate scattered across an Indonesian kitchen floor, with bare feet of a person standing frozen nearby * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Authentic humble Indonesian home kitchen with smooth grey unpolished cement floor (lantai semen plesteran), weathered wooden cabinet edge, traditional broom leaning against the wall * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] The hesitation and visceral pause of a person looking down at the sudden break, emotional tension suspended in stillness * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] The glossy split reflection on the ceramic shards subtly fractures into two distinct hues on the floor: a faint stress-induced crimson warmth on one side and a soothing cool dewdrop clear tone on the other * [LIGHTING] Low-angle morning window light slicing across the cement floor, casting elongated soft shadows and catching sharp ceramic edges * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Sharp porcelain ceramic glaze, porous raw matte concrete, natural skin texture of bare feet, fine dust particles in air * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 perspective, top-down angled shot looking at the floor fragments, spacious negative space in upper third * [STYLE] Intimate editorial documentary photography, 35mm film still, Leica M aesthetic, desaturated earth tones with terracotta and bone accents * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No melodramatic facial grimace, no 3D computer graphics, no text, no captions, no floating sci-fi icons, no blood, no messy cartoon clutter
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Obrolan Bawah Kolong: Insiden Piring Pecah
self_reflection_check: Pernah capek seharian, lalu hal kecil di dapur saja sudah cukup bikin meledak? Kadang yang pecah bukan cuma piring.
teaser: Hal kecil bisa meledakkan kita ketika tubuh sudah terlalu lama menahan beban.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Sakit di Tubuh, Sakit di Hati
side_a_text: Otakmu tidak membedakan luka duri atau kata hinaan. Semuanya terasa menusuk bila cermin batinmu terlalu rapuh dan keruh.
visual_concept: Seseorang duduk bersandar lunglai di ambang pintu kayu beranda rumah desa berkabut, memegang pergelangan kakinya yang tersandung; hembusan napas di dadanya dan denyut di kakinya beresonansi dalam satu getaran biologis yang sama.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian person sitting slumped on a low weathered wooden doorstep (ambang pintu jati) of an old village house * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] A rustic porch with red terracotta floor tiles, mountain village mist drifting outside in the background, a clay water jug resting in the corner * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] One hand resting gently on their chest over the sternum while their bare foot rests on the cool tile, an expression of quiet somatic exhaustion and deep release * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] A subtle, almost invisible thread of warm morning condensation connects the pulse in the chest to the foot, visualising the unified biological pain circuit * [LIGHTING] Soft diffuse overcast mountain light, cool exterior mist contrasting with the dim warm interior doorway * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Aged weathered dark teak wood, matte terracotta tile texture with natural patina, soft breathable cotton fabric * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 framing, full seated figure in the lower frame framed by the rustic doorframe, clear misty upper half providing quiet negative space * [STYLE] Poetic realism, 35mm film grain, muted sage green, deep earth brown, and terracotta palette, contemplative fine art photography * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No glowing holographic brain scans, no futuristic wires, no medical illustration overlays, no text, no cheesy melodrama, no oversaturated colors
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Kebocoran Energi Manusia Modern: Menyamakan Sakit Fisik dan Batin
self_reflection_check: Seharian hampir nggak ke mana-mana, tapi malamnya badan seperti habis dipakai lari. Kalau kaki nggak ke mana-mana, yang lari seharian apa?
teaser: Jempol tersandung terasa sakit. Dikhianati juga sakit. Otak ternyata tidak sesederhana yang kita kira.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Tubuh yang Menyalakan Alarm
side_a_text: Tubuhmu gemetar seperti dikepung serigala buas di rimba, padahal yang datang hanyalah selembar kertas tagihan di atas meja.
visual_concept: Kamar tidur sederhana rumah Jawa sebelum fajar; seseorang berbaring diam di kasur kapuk berselimut lurik, menatap langit-langit reng genteng kayu saat udara fajar dingin mulai masuk melalui celah jendela, memadamkan kepanikan batin.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian individual lying still on a traditional cotton-stuffed kapok mattress, hands resting gently on the stomach * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Simple traditional Javanese bedroom, woven gedheg bamboo wall on one side, wooden louvered window slightly cracked open to the pre-dawn sky * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Taking a slow conscious breath in the stillness, relaxing tense elevated shoulders, transitioning from chronic hypervigilance to somatic surrender * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] A subtle atmospheric gradient in the air: the faint dry dust haze near a face-down phone dissolving into cool crystalline pre-dawn mountain vapor entering from the window * [LIGHTING] Twilight pre-dawn blue hour (fajar sadik) mixed with faint amber horizon glow through the window slats * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Woven handloom lurik fabric blanket, natural kapok mattress folds, rough bamboo weave, cool humid dawn air * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 high-angle perspective looking down at the resting figure, ample calm negative space in the upper shadows * [STYLE] Editorial meditative photography, cinematic film still, analog grain, earthy charcoal and indigo tones with pale dawn gold * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No cartoon comic hormones, no neon glowing forcefields, no sci-fi medical HUD, no text, no digital clock overlays, no exaggerated poses
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Perang Biokimiawi: Mode Survival vs Regenerasi
self_reflection_check: Ada pesan masuk, bahu langsung naik. Belum dibaca saja badan sudah bereaksi. Pernah sadar sampai situ?
teaser: Pesan belum dibuka, bahu sudah naik. Tubuh kadang bereaksi sebelum pikiran sempat mengerti.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Ketika Tubuh Mulai Berkarat
side_a_text: Kamu meminum racun dendam setiap malam sebelum tidur, lalu berharap racun itu membunuh orang yang menyakitimu.
visual_concept: Sudut halaman belakang rumah kampung berlumut; seorang pria menyentuh tiang besi tua yang mengelupas berkarat di samping pot tanah liat, sembari menghembuskan napas panjang seolah meluruhkan karat keletihan menahun dari sel raganya.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian man in his 30s standing in a rustic backyard, touching a weathered rusted iron pillar near mossy brickwork * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Backyard of an old Indonesian village house with damp red brick walls, overgrown betel vines (daun sirih), clay pots, and damp earth * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Exhaling deeply with closed eyes, feeling the somatic release of long-held tension, sensing the frailty and resilience of the physical body * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] Fine particles of reddish-brown iron rust gently scattering from the metal, mirroring the visual idea of cellular oxidative stress dissipating into thin morning air * [LIGHTING] Overcast damp morning light, soft directional shadows, subtle silver glints on moisture droplets * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Flaking oxidized iron texture, rough porous moss-covered bricks, damp green tropical foliage, natural human skin * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 composition, side profile medium shot, generous negative space in the upper portion framed by damp foliage * [STYLE] Gritty yet poetic documentary photography, 35mm film grain, rich earth palette with terracotta rust, slate grey, and moss green * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No sci-fi glowing cells, no floating 3D molecular models, no horror zombie decay, no text, no clinical laboratory backdrops
self_reflection_check: Pernah badan terasa berat padahal pekerjaan hari itu biasa saja? Jangan-jangan ada sesuatu yang terus kamu bawa di kepala sampai badan ikut kebagian.
teaser: Stres yang dibiarkan lama-lama bukan cuma membuat pikiran lelah. Tubuh ikut membayar.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Kesenangan Instan, Rasa Hampa
side_a_text: Kesenangan instan di layar ponsel terasa manis di lidah, tetapi ia meninggalkan jiwamu kelaparan di dasar sunyi.
visual_concept: Di bengkel kerja kayu temaram, seorang pengrajin ukir Jawa tekun menorehkan pahat ke serat kayu jati wangi; di sudut meja jauh tergeletak ponsel pintar yang padam tak tersentuh, kontras antara candu instan dan kepuasan tirakat.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian artisan in traditional casual attire, deeply immersed in woodcarving at a rustic studio workbench * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] A dimly lit traditional Javanese artisan workshop (bengkel kriya), scattered wood shavings, chisels, hand tools, dark teakwood beams * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Intense yet serene absorption in manual craftsmanship, a quiet smile of grounded purpose, completely undisturbed by an untouched dark phone resting far away * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] Fragrant wood shavings curling from the chisel blade catch a warm amber golden glow, embodying the slow, enduring richness of ancestral sustained dopamine * [LIGHTING] Single directional beam of late afternoon golden sunlight cutting across the dust motes of the timber workshop * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Raw seasoned teak grain, sharp steel gouges, curled wood ribbons, textured rough cotton clothing * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 orientation, close-medium shot focusing on hands and contemplative face, dark uncluttered negative space in upper third * [STYLE] Editorial cultural portraiture, Hasselblad medium format film look, deep charcoal, walnut brown, and warm honey gold palette * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No digital neon graphs, no floating dopamine chemical formulas, no cartoonish smartphone addiction tropes, no text, no plastic studio lighting
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Dilema Dopamin: Candu Instan vs Laku Tirakat
self_reflection_check: Dua jam scrolling bisa bikin capek, tapi selesai mengerjakan satu hal kecil malah terasa lega. Capeknya sama-sama capek. Kok rasanya beda?
teaser: Dua jam di layar bisa lewat begitu saja. Menyelesaikan satu hal kecil kadang justru terasa lebih menghidupkan.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Belajar Menahan Pahit
side_a_text: Siapa yang rakus menelan manisnya kepalsuan hari ini, sedang menabung kepedihan panjang untuk ditebus esok hari.
visual_concept: Pagi buta berselimut kabut di samping sumur timba batu kali di desa pegunungan; seseorang menyiramkan sebatok air sumur yang dingin menusuk ke tengkuknya, melatih saraf raga agar bersahabat dengan kesulitan hidup.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian man standing beside a traditional stone well in a misty highland village at 4:30 AM * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Back courtyard of a rustic house with an old hand-drawn stone well (sumur timba batu kali), mossy stone pavers, banana leaves wet with heavy morning dew * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Splashing fresh cold well water from a traditional coconut shell scoop (siwur batok kelapa) onto the back of his neck, an expression of sharp awakening, stoic discipline, and inner steel * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] The cold water droplets hitting the warm skin create an instant plume of crystalline pure vapor, visually anchoring the deliberate thermal shock and resilience * [LIGHTING] Deep pre-dawn twilight indigo atmosphere with the faintest warm rim-light of approaching sunrise kissing the water droplets * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Rough porous river stones, polished coconut shell grain, wet human skin, cold well rope texture, lush wet vegetation * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 composition, dynamic low-angle medium shot, spacious shadowy negative space in the upper misty canopy * [STYLE] Atmospheric documentary realism, 35mm Tri-X film grain aesthetic in rich color, deep indigo, slate, and earthy tones * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No Wim Hof ice bath commercial tropes, no modern plastic gym setting, no text, no screaming face, no artificial fitness branding
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Filosofi Semesta: Membayar Kepahitan di Depan
self_reflection_check: Kita sering bilang ingin bebas, tapi sedikit tidak nyaman saja buru-buru cari hiburan. Kenyamanan apa yang paling susah kamu tinggalkan?
teaser: Sedikit tidak nyaman saja kita buru-buru mencari hiburan. Padahal ketahanan juga perlu dilatih.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Tiga Benteng Naluri Bertahan Hidup
side_a_text: Jangan bermimpi melompat memeluk langit spiritual, jika tapak kakimu sendiri masih enggan menyentuh debu kenyataan bumi.
visual_concept: Seseorang duduk bersila di atas tikar pandan lantai tanah joglo terbuka; di dekatnya terdapat tungku tanah liat (anglo) dengan bara arang merah yang menyala stabil, merefleksikan tungku bawah raga yang menjaga naluri bertahan hidup tetap terkendali.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian man seated in cross-legged stillness on a handwoven pandanus floor mat (tikar pandan) * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Open veranda of a rustic rural Javanese home with earthen floor, a traditional terracotta charcoal brazier (anglo tanah liat) resting nearby * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Centered pelvic alignment, grounding both sitting bones into the earth, serene control over primal instinctual restlessness * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] The deep warm terracotta glow of embers inside the clay brazier harmoniously echoes the warmth of the lower pelvic girdle and abdomen, symbolizing the grounded lower biological furnace * [LIGHTING] Low dusk light mixing with the deep warm red-amber ember glow from the clay stove, casting long grounded shadows * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Natural braided pandan weave, rough terracotta clay texture, smoldering hardwood charcoal, weathered wooden posts * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 framing, grounded low camera angle emphasizing connection to earth, calm negative space in the upper shadowy rafters * [STYLE] Fine art ethnographic photography, 35mm film grain, muted palette dominated by charcoal black, burnt umber, terracotta, and deep earth tones * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No glowing holographic chakra discs, no new-age alien yoga graphics, no rainbow cartoon flares, no text, no commercial fitness attire
source_anchor: Bab 3 > 7 Cakra & 7 Wilayah Endokrin: Stasiun Bio-Elektrik Saraf (Bagian 1: Cakra 1-3)
self_reflection_check: Kalau uangmu berkurang, makananmu terganggu, atau rasa amanmu terusik, mana yang paling cepat bikin pikiranmu berubah? Di situ biasanya kelihatan apa yang paling kamu jaga.
teaser: Uang, makanan, rasa aman. Begitu salah satunya terusik, kita baru tahu apa yang paling kita takutkan kehilangan.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Empat Menara Menuju Langit Batin
side_a_text: Suaramu menembus sanubari manusia bukan karena kepandaian lidahmu, melainkan karena dadamu memancarkan keheningan yang tulus.
visual_concept: Seseorang berdiri hening di teras batu purba lereng gunung saat senja beralih ke malam berbintang; postur tegak dari dada hingga ubun-ubun membiaskan udara pegunungan yang sangat jernih.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian person standing tall in profound stillness on an open highland plateau overlooking a quiet valley under a vast twilight sky * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Ancient weathered andesite stone terrace surrounded by mountain flora, cool highland breeze gently rustling natural woven cotton fabric * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Upright spine, chest naturally open without strain, throat relaxed, eyes softly gazing upward in reverent wonder and tranquil awareness * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] The twilight mountain air around the neck and crown of the head possesses a pristine, crystalline clarity that subtly refracts the faint ambient celestial light like pure spring water * [LIGHTING] Deep twilight indigo transitions to starlight, soft natural rim-light from the western horizon fading into cosmic dusk * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Weathered volcanic stone texture, raw handspun loom-woven cloth, mountain mist, clear atmospheric depth * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 silhouette-to-medium shot, figure anchored in the lower half with majestic, vast nocturnal sky filling the upper negative space * [STYLE] Majestic poetic realism, medium format film look, deep indigo, charcoal, sage green, and faint silver-starlight accents * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No glowing rainbow chakras, no floating laser beams, no sci-fi cyborg skulls, no text, no generic new-age guru stock photos
source_anchor: Bab 3 > 7 Cakra & 7 Wilayah Endokrin: Puncak Mahkota Kesadaran (Bagian 2: Cakra 4-7)
self_reflection_check: Pernah ada satu kalimat yang sebenarnya ingin kamu sampaikan kepada orang dekat, tapi kamu tahan karena takut hubungan berubah? Sampai sekarang masih ada?
teaser: Dari dada ke kepala, ada perjalanan tentang kasih, keberanian berkata benar, kesadaran, dan keheningan.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Bharatayuddha di Dalam Kepala
side_a_text: Pertarungan terbesar tidak terjadi di medan perang dunia, melainkan di antara dua bisikan yang saling berebut takhta di rongga dadamu.
visual_concept: Di balik kelir kain mori wayang kulit yang temaram diterangi lampu blencong, bayangan tokoh wayang Sengkuni yang licik dan Kresna yang agung berhadapan tepat pada kontur siluet kepala seorang penonton yang duduk hening.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian spectator sitting quietly behind the white cotton screen (kelir) of a traditional Javanese shadow puppet theater * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Traditional joglo night pavilion, a flickering bronze oil lamp (lampu blencong), banana tree trunk puppet base (gedebog pisang) resting in warm shadows * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Deep introspective observation, realizing that the internal mental conflict is just a dramatic performance projected on consciousness * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] The dark leather shadow of cunning puppet Sengkuni and noble crowned Kresna projected onto the mori cloth softly converge with the contour of the human profile * [LIGHTING] Warm flickering coconut-oil flame illumination creating dramatic soft dancing shadows against the natural cotton screen * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Chiseled buffalo leather shadow puppet (wayang kulit tatahan), unbleached natural mori cotton fabric, aged teakwood floor, oil smoke haze * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 framing, off-center profile view, expansive quiet shadowy upper region for editorial typography * [STYLE] Cinematic Javanese noir, 35mm analog film aesthetic, Kodak Tri-X / warm sepia-amber tone, deep blacks and bone-white screen contrast * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No modern neon puppets, no cartoon caricature faces, no futuristic sci-fi brain graphics, no text, no gaudy carnival lighting
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Dekonstruksi Sanepo Epos Mahabharata dalam Anatomi Saraf
self_reflection_check: Pernah curiga duluan, padahal buktinya belum ada? Waktu itu benar-benar intuisi, atau pikiranmu sedang bikin film sendiri?
teaser: Ada Sengkuni yang curiga, ada Kresna yang melihat lebih jernih. Pertarungannya ternyata berlangsung di dalam diri sendiri.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Ganesha, Kera Liar, dan Pikiranmu
side_a_text: Mitologi purba tidak sedang menceritakan dewa-dewa asing di awan, mereka sedang menggambar peta raga yang kamu bawa mandi setiap hari.
visual_concept: Di pelataran candi batu kuno lereng gunung yang lembap berlumut, seorang musafir menyentuh relief batu andesit bermotif gajah dan kera purba, sembari tangan satunya memegang tengkuknya sendiri yang berdenyut seirama.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian traveler in understated travel attire examining an ancient moss-covered stone bas-relief at a quiet mountain temple * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Atmospheric courtyard of a secluded highland volcanic stone sanctuary (candi lereng Gunung Lawu), damp mountain mist, ancient ferns sprouting from stone crevices * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] One hand lightly touching the carved stone contour with deep reverence, while the other hand rests unconsciously on their own nape/neck in sudden somatic recognition * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] The carved elephant trunk and monkey motifs on the weather-worn andesite stone visually align with the natural curve of the human cervical spine and occiput * [LIGHTING] Diffuse overcast mountain mist, cool soft shadows with tiny dew reflections on dark volcanic rock * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Porous weathered dark volcanic andesite stone, green velvet moss, ancient carved relief textures, soft damp tropical atmosphere * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 orientation, close-up to medium profile framing the stone relief and human silhouette, calm foggy upper third * [STYLE] National Geographic style cultural archaeology, 35mm documentary film grain, muted palette of slate stone grey, moss green, and weathered bark * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No fantasy RPG stone golems, no floating magical runes, no alien hieroglyphics, no text, no cheesy souvenir-tourist vibe
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Bukti Simbolisme Mitologi Dunia: Ganesha, Anubis & Sun Go Kong
self_reflection_check: Pikiranmu baru diajak mikir satu hal, lima detik kemudian sudah jalan-jalan ke mana-mana. Yang lucu, siapa yang sadar kalau pikiranmu sedang ke mana-mana?
teaser: Pikiran bisa meloncat ke mana-mana seperti kera. Lalu siapa yang menyadari bahwa ia sedang meloncat?

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Ritme Tiga Puluh Lima Hari
side_a_text: Raga ini memiliki musimnya sendiri untuk gugur dan bersemi. Kamu saja yang terlalu bising hingga lupa mendengarkan denyutnya.
visual_concept: Di kamar sentong tua rumah kayu Jawa yang gelap gulita tanpa cahaya lampu, seseorang duduk tenang di atas bale bambu; di dekatnya air sumur dalam mangkuk tanah liat memantulkan siklus kalender Jawa selapanan di atas daun lontar.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian individual seated peacefully in silent meditation inside an authentic darkened wooden heritage room (kamar sentong) * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Secluded quiet interior of a timber Javanese house, dark teak walls, bamboo slatted daybed (bale-bale), unbleached white cotton cloth * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Deep restorative stillness of fasting (laku pati geni), eyes gently closed, breath barely visible, biological surrender to darkness * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] A simple terracotta water bowl beside an ancient inscribed palm leaf manuscript (daun lontar) recording the circular 35-day calendar cycle in natural earth pigments * [LIGHTING] Minimalist, ultra-low ambient light, soft sliver of cool daylight slipping through a tiny timber seam, illuminating dust in slow motion * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Handwoven raw mori cotton, aged rough teak timber, dry palm leaf texture, matte dark clay * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16, minimalist composition, deep shadowy negative space occupying the top half, serene resting subject in lower third * [STYLE] Chiaroscuro fine art photography, analog medium format aesthetic, Rembrandt lighting in deep umber, charcoal, and ivory tones * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No glowing magical calendars, no sci-fi floating holograms, no horror creepy darkness, no text, no candle fire clichés
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Biohacking Kuno: Siklus 35 Hari Selapanan, Puasa Apit Weton & Pati Geni
self_reflection_check: Kapan terakhir kali kamu benar-benar diam tanpa layar, tanpa suara, tanpa mencari sesuatu untuk mengisi waktu? Baru di situ biasanya kita tahu kepala kita seramai apa.
teaser: Tubuh punya ritmenya sendiri. Kadang kita perlu berhenti mengikuti jam dunia untuk mendengarnya.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Membersihkan Sisa Hari
side_a_text: Beban berat di pundakmu sehabis melangkah jauh bukanlah kutukan gaib, melainkan debu keletihan yang rindu dilarungkan air garam.
visual_concept: Di teras belakang rumah pedesaan dekat kebun rimbun, sepasang tangan basah meraup segenggam garam krosok kasar non-rafinasi di atas baskom tembikar, di samping rimbun daun kelor segar berembun pagi.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] Weathered yet gentle Indonesian hands cradling a generous handful of raw, coarse unrefined sea salt crystals (garam krosok) over a large terracotta washing basin * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] A damp garden terrace in Java surrounded by thriving wild moringa trees (pohon kelor), rustic bamboo water spout, smooth river stones * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Cleansing ritual, washing away heavy static fatigue, a feeling of tactile grounding and cellular purification through elemental earth * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] Freshly picked vibrant green moringa leaves resting in the clear water alongside the dissolved mineral crystals create micro-ripples of pure translucent clarity * [LIGHTING] Fresh, crisp morning sun filtering through green tree leaves, casting delicate dappled light and water caustics onto terracotta * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Coarse crystalline halite salt texture, organic matte terracotta clay, dewy velvety moringa foliage, cool clear water droplets * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 macro-to-medium intimate shot focusing on hands and basin, generous tranquil leafy negative space in upper third * [STYLE] Organic tactile botanical photography, 35mm film still, Leica color science, lush botanical green, wet terracotta, and mineral white palette * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No supermarket iodized salt boxes, no mystical blue magic sparks, no spa commercial shampoo model aesthetics, no text, no plastic containers
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Sains Grounding: Garam Krosok & Daun Kelor
self_reflection_check: Pulang setelah seharian ketemu banyak orang, tapi rasanya semua kejadian tadi masih menempel di badan. Kamu biasanya benar-benar pulang, atau cuma pindah tempat?
teaser: Ada hari yang selesai di jam kerja, tapi belum selesai di badan. Garam, kelor, dan ritual sederhana masuk ke cerita ini.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Menarik Rem Lewat Napas
side_a_text: Napas panjang adalah rem batin yang diwariskan semesta. Tarik napasmu ke dasar jiwa, dan saksikan badai di kepalamu mereda.
visual_concept: Seseorang duduk bersila di bale bambu tepi persawahan berkabut saat matahari fajar menyingsing; hembusan napasnya yang panjang dan teratur melalui celah bibir tampak meredakan riak air di sekitarnya menjadi tenang laksana cermin.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian individual seated upright with relaxed shoulders on a wooden veranda overlooking serene terraced rice paddies * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Open wooden pavilion (bale bengong) surrounded by green rice fields at 6 AM, misty volcanic mountains in the far distance * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Exhaling slowly and continuously through gently parted lips, stomach softening inward, facial muscles completely smoothed in deep parasympathetic release * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] The elongated steady exhalation visible in the cool morning air creates a calm, rhythmic wave pattern that smooths out any turbulence in the atmosphere * [LIGHTING] Golden hour dawn light just breaking behind mountain mist, warm soft glow grazing the cheekbones and hands resting on knees * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Natural bamboo slats, weathered timber grain, soft linen attire, morning fog condensation, peaceful still water surfaces * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 framing, seated figure anchored in lower half, majestic morning sky and rice terraces offering vast peaceful negative space above * [STYLE] Meditative editorial landscape photography, Hasselblad medium format look, sage green, golden straw, and sky-blue dawn tones * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No floating 4-4-8 digital numbers, no fitness stopwatch UI, no yoga studio stock photo stereotypes, no text, no unnatural stiff poses
source_anchor: Bab 3 > Protokol Eksekusi: Panduan Napas Parasimpatis 4-4-8 & Master Matrix
self_reflection_check: Kalau panik datang, kita sering ikut panik karena ingin paniknya cepat hilang. Coba tarik napas dan buang pelan. Lihat dulu apa tubuhmu bisa diajak turun.
teaser: Ketika tubuh menyalakan alarm, jangan selalu dilawan. Kadang napas yang panjang bisa mengajak tubuh turun.

chapter_name: Sistem Hormon, Biohacking Leluhur & Energi Fisik
title: Menjadi Tuan di Rumah Sendiri
side_a_text: Kuasai dulu kerajaan di dalam pembuluh darahmu sendiri, sebelum kamu lancang ingin mengatur angin di luar rumah.
visual_concept: Seseorang berdiri tegak dan tenang dengan kaki telanjang menjejak pasir vulkanik lereng Gunung Merapi saat pagi benderang; tapak kakinya menyatu kokoh dengan tunas-tunas rumput liar yang tumbuh di tanah abu subur.
image_prompt: [SUBJECT] An Indonesian man in simple traditional linen clothes standing tall, grounded, and centered in front of a majestic Merapi volcano landscape * [ORDINARY INDONESIAN ENVIRONMENT] Expansive slope of black volcanic sand and hardy mountain shrubs (rumput liar lereng Merapi) under crisp morning sunshine * [HUMAN ACTION / EMOTION] Standing barefoot with grounded posture, chin level, eyes looking steadily at the horizon with profound quiet sovereignty and grounded dignity * [ONE VISUAL METAPHOR] The impression of bare feet on the rich dark volcanic earth subtly integrates with tiny fresh green sprouts breaking through the mineral sand * [LIGHTING] Brilliant, clear high-altitude morning sunlight casting sharp, clean shadows, crisp mountain air with exceptional clarity * [MATERIAL / TEXTURE] Fine black volcanic sand texture, weathered volcanic basalt boulders, coarse natural unbleached linen fabric, healthy skin texture * [COMPOSITION] Vertical 9:16 heroic yet serene composition, subject standing dignified in the lower two-thirds, vast clear blue-sky negative space above * [STYLE] Majestic fine art documentary photography, 35mm film aesthetic, Kodak Ektar color richness, charcoal black sand, emerald green, and cobalt blue palette * [NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS] No superhero capes, no fantasy glowing auras, no sci-fi cyborg armor, no text, no cheesy motivational poster poses

self_reflection_check: Lepas alas kaki sebentar. Rasakan telapak kakimu menyentuh lantai atau tanah. Kita tiap hari tinggal di dalam tubuh ini, tapi jarang benar-benar menyadari sedang berada di sana.
teaser: Kita tiap hari tinggal di dalam tubuh ini. Anehnya, kita sering lupa sedang berada di sana.
